description:

We are seeking a Data Center Operations Implementation Manager to own the end-to-end Day 0 to Day 2 transition of Nscale's data centres - spanning construction, fit-out, and live, steady-state local operations - across an assigned region and set of sites. Rather than owning construction execution itself, you'll be the connective tissue between Construction, Network Engineering, Compute/Infrastructure Deployment, and local Operations teams - driving a structured, well-documented transition so every site goes live on schedule and ready to support production workloads. This is an individual-contributor role built on strong stakeholder management, cross-functional influence, and travel to sites during critical transition windows.

• Own the end-to-end Day 0 to Day 2 transition process for each data centre site within your assigned region - spanning construction, fit-out, and steady-state operations.

• Define and maintain a standardized transition framework and readiness checklist applied consistently across your assigned sites.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Coordination

Description de l’IMT Nord Europe :

École sous tutelle du ministère de l’économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique, IMT Nord Europe est née en 2017 de la fusion de Télécom Lille et de l’École des Mines de Douai. Elle compte aujourd’hui parmi les plus Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs au Nord de Paris avec plus 2200 élèves, dont un quart d’apprentis, plus de 600 diplômés par an et un réseau de 15 000 diplômés. Elle fait partie de l’Institut Mines Télécom, premier groupe public de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France, et est partenaire de l’université de Lille.
IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.
Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20 000 m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les trois domaines « Systèmes Numériques », « Energie Environnement » et « Matériaux et Procédés ».
Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr

Contexte scientifique et missions :

Le développement de capteurs autonomes en énergie pour l'Internet des objets (IoT) représente un défi scientifique et technologique majeur. Dans ce contexte, les technologies de récupération d'énergie constituent des solutions prometteuses pour convertir différentes sources d'énergie présentes dans notre environnement (mécanique, thermique, solaire, électromagnétique, etc.) en énergie électrique.
Le projet européen THERMOHARV , réunissant l'Université de Mons, l'Université de Lille, le C2DE et l’IMT Nord Europe, ambitionne de développer une nouvelle génération de microgénérateurs thermoélectriques organiques (OTEG), flexibles et performants , capables de convertir directement la chaleur fatale en énergie électrique. Ces dispositifs pourraient notamment contribuer à l'alimentation de capteurs autonomes dans les bâtiments, les centres de données ou les environnements industriels.

title: Manager, Market Access Operations
description:
Secura Bio was established in 2019 with a singular mission: to close the gap between innovative oncology therapies and the patients who need them most. Our high-touch approach is informed by our decades of experience shaping the impact of oncology’s largest clinical and market opportunities. We know that true impact comes from personalization and an unwavering commitment to serve patients and expand the possibilities of life-prolonging oncology medicines.

About the Role

The Manager, Market Access Operations makes sure Secura Bio 's pricing, 340B, government programs, contracting and channel operations are accurate, compliant and run well. This person is the operations lead for the Market Access team within Commercial Operations. They work with Finance and the government pricing vendor to coordinate and check pricing calculations and submissions. The role manages the 340B program day to day, along with contract operations and channel partners, and provides market access insights to the Commercial team. This is a remote position.

Employment Type

Full-time

Reports To

Executive Director, Commercial Operations & Analytics

Key Responsibilities

Pricing Management

• Coordinate list price (WAC) changes from approval through implementation.

• Send pricing notices to drug pricing databases (such as Medi-Span, First Databank and Red Book), channel partners and customers on time.

• Manage state drug price transparency reporting and advance notices of price increases. Keep a calendar of state requirements.

• Work with Finance to model the impact of pricing decisions on gross-to-net, government programs and inflation rebates.

• Maintain the pricing governance documents, price history and approval records.

Government Pricing Coordination

• Serve as the main operations contact with Finance and the outside vendor for monthly and quarterly government price calculations and submissions. These include AMP, Best Price, ASP, Non-FAMP and Federal Ceiling Price.

• Collaborate with Finance in support of sales, contract and chargeback data that feed the calculations. Make sure it is complete and accurate.

• Review vendor results for accuracy and unusual changes. Investigate differences and record findings before submissions are approved.

• Manage the reporting calendar so all deadlines are met.

• Support Medicaid Drug Rebate Program, VA FSS and TRICARE operations, including rebate invoice validation, dispute resolution and contract coordination.

• Help keep government pricing policies, methods and assumptions documented and current, with Finance, Legal and Compliance.

• Track regulatory changes, such as Inflation Reduction Act inflation rebates and CMS guidance, and flag operational impacts.

340B Program Management

• Manage Secura Bio 's 340B program day to day, in line with HRSA requirements and company policy.

• Work with Finance and the vendor to check 340B ceiling prices each quarter. Confirm they are correctly loaded into the government's 340B pricing system and wholesaler systems.

• Monitor how 340B prices are applied through chargebacks. Investigate pricing errors, refunds and restatements.

• Monitor 340B purchasing and contract pharmacy activity. Coordinate with vendors on claims data and on identifying duplicate discounts with Medicaid.

• Support 340B policy decisions, audits of covered entities, disputes and HRSA inquiries, with Legal and Compliance.

• Keep 340B documentation audit-ready and track legal and regulatory changes.

Contracting and Gross-to-Net

• Manage how payer, specialty pharmacy, distributor and GPO contracts are carried out, including fee-for-service, data fees, rebates, chargebacks and administrative fees.

• Validate rebate claims, chargebacks and fee invoices. Resolve disputes.

• Work with Finance on gross-to-net forecasting, accruals and month-end close. Explain differences between forecast and actual.

• Keep the contract inventory current and track key terms, renewals and obligations.

• Develop, maintain, and improve regulatory procedures, processes, and SOPs to support a compliant and efficient regulatory function.

• Manage regulatory data, reporting, and documentation within regulatory information management systems to support inspections, audits, and business needs.

• Lead multiple regulatory projects simultaneously, balancing priorities, timelines, and business objectives while maintaining a high level of accountability.

• Serve as a trusted regulatory subject matter expert, applying sound judgment and technical expertise to resolve complex regulatory issues and support business growth.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s Degree in a scientific discipline or equivalent work experience, preferred.

• 3+ years regulatory affairs experience preferred.

• Experience in medical device industry a plus.

• Proficiency in International STED and regulations, technical documents, and US FDA medical devices regulations highly preferred.

• Strong organizational, problem-solving, and time management skills highly desired.

• Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines, highly desired.

• Team-oriented with a collaborative approach to work, highly desired.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, highly desired.
